hypothesis: Bounded offline compression of physical episodes into causal rule masks improves cold-restored prediction on never-witnessed state-action pairs over equal-size episodic recall, without increasing confident errors or losing previously learned contexts.
design: Synthetic, no-token, no-gradient, no-model; online physical experiences collected in two contexts, 16 distinct transitions per context, returned to first context for cold-retention. Sleep does not query simulator. Source rule family is fixed, so grammar novelty is not tested.
memory: Each arm maximum 320 logical causal-program mask bits plus at most 32 physical episode tuples where relevant; compare actual serialized bytes separately. Offline sleep receives exactly the same transitions as controls; no extra action budget.
negative_controls: No sleep versus sleep; dream generated predictions not allowed to become empirical evidence; conventional exact same grammar and memory; prove evaluator outputs cannot influence updates; cold snapshot tamper rejection
decision: Development-only signal if thresholds reached; conventional tie or superior means no Yggdrasil-specific scientific advantage. Scientific acceptance remains unverified. Any failure stays negative; no tuning of seeds/thresholds after results.
boundaries: No merge, native model, main, controller, autonomous loop, first-use scientific data or weight-programming mutation
No paid APIs, GPUs, gradient training or language-token foundation
